searchText: Oh I didn't know this, I missed the difference between SLOT_COUNT and SLOT_EXCESS My assumption was also that it sets the fee based on the queue length Wasn't this the point of the fee mechanism? The fee mechanism is to avoid someone filling the queue for days + weeks with spam. Right now it updates on a per block basis. We could make it update on demand as new txs come in, but it would need a little more logic to determine if the current slot's count should be added to excess or not. Also there originally wasn't a way to get the current fee so we thought that only changing per block might be a little more stable and reduce the risk that someone's request becomes stale. I don't think that is as much of a problem now
